subject: MAP: POC evaluation kickoff & roster — roles, benchmarks, timeline
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Priya Anand <priya@cardiotech.io>, Evan Brooks <evan.b@cardiotech.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: POC evaluation kickoff & roster — roles, benchmarks, timeline

Hi Priya and Evan —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. Per our conversation, I’ve attached a draft mutual action plan (MAP) and a baseline benchmarks CSV to get the POC scoped. Goal for this thread: confirm success criteria, ownership for prompts/evals, and a tight 4-week timeline so we can align procurement and infra.

High-level POC plan (4 weeks):
- Week 0 (this week): access, dataset stub, security checklist completed (Kimberly leads)
- Week 1: baseline ingestion + synthetic prompt run (benchmarks collected)
- Week 2: prompt tuning and prompt-owner-led evaluation cycles
- Week 3: quality/regression sweeps + performance tuning (latency/throughput)
- Week 4: results review, acceptance test, SOW sign-off

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
- Quality: evaluation benchmark F1 >= 0.85 on the labeled test set, or precision/recall tradeoffs documented
- Latency: median generation latency <= 300ms for 512-token context in our dedicated bucket
- Throughput: sustained 20 RPS with 95th percentile latency under 800ms during soak testing
- Safety/regulatory: no PHI leakage in outputs when run over redacted sample; SOC2 evidence collected

Suggested owners (please confirm or propose alternates):
- POC sponsor (CardioTech): Dr. Priya Anand (product/clinical lead)
- Redwood POC lead: Sergio Alvarez (infra + rollout)
- Prompt owner (testing/tuning): Ben Carter
- Eval owner (metrics, bench design): Laura Bennett
- Security/compliance owner: Kimberly Park
- CS/Success coordination: Marissa Cole

Attachments: MAP_Draft_v0.9.xlsx (timeline + milestones), baseline-benchmarks.csv (sample inputs/labels), SOW-draft-CardioTech.docx (initial commercial terms)

Ask: Priya/Evan — can you confirm the internal stakeholders on your side and whether PHI data will be used in the POC? If PHI is involved, we’ll default to a private deployment pattern and Kimberly will send the minimal evidence checklist.

I’ll hold a 30-minute kickoff for next Wednesday (Aug 18) at 10am PT unless you prefer a different slot.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.ai
From: Dr. Priya Anand <priya@cardiotech.io>

Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 10:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC evaluation kickoff & roster — roles, benchmarks, timeline

Thanks, Sergio — this reads well. Two quick notes from CardioTech: we will provide a de-identified dataset for the baseline runs (no PHI in the initial upload), but we will want to validate with a small PHI-parallel sample under a private environment later in Week 2.

Internal CardioTech attendees: myself (clinical lead), Evan Brooks (engineering lead), and I’ll pull in our security lead if/when we move to the PHI sample — I’ll confirm that person’s contact tomorrow.

Success criteria look good; a couple tweaks we care about:
- Please add an item to verify end-to-end schema fidelity (JSON traceability) — we need deterministic tokenization mapping for downstream analytics.
- For quality, can you add an acceptance gate that flags any hallucination rate > 5% on the labeled set?

Wednesday Aug 18 at 10am PT works for us. I’ll send a calendar invite after Evan confirms.

Best,
Priya
Dr. Priya Anand
VP of Product, CardioTech
priya@cardiotech.io
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Priya Anand <priya@cardiotech.io>, Evan Brooks <evan.b@cardiotech.io>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC evaluation kickoff & roster — roles, benchmarks, timeline

Thanks Priya — and great to meet you (virtually). Quick operational notes and owner confirmations from Redwood: 

Bench / Eval plan (concrete):
- Baseline collection (Ben): run baseline-benchmarks.csv against our hosted sandbox; Ben will capture per-prompt metrics and push results to the shared sheet by Friday EOD.
- Prompt iteration (Ben + CardioTech): two cycles during Week 2; each cycle includes prompt variants, automatic scoring, and manual spot checks.
- Evaluation matrix (Laura): define pass/fail gates (F1, hallucination rate, schema fidelity) and maintain the evaluation notebook in Drive. Laura will publish the first draft of the eval matrix by Wednesday morning.
- Infra soak (Sergio): deploy dedicated bucket for soak testing Week 3; will run load tests to validate 20 RPS target.
- Security checklist (Kimberly): I’ve looped Kimberly for the PHI checklist — she’ll circulate the minimum required attestations for private runs and an evidence list for SOC2 artifacts.

Acceptance gates (to be recorded in MAP):
- Quality gate: F1 >= 0.85 AND hallucination rate <= 5% OR documented trade-offs agreed in writing
- Performance gate: median latency <= 300ms for canonical requests + soak at 20 RPS w/ 95p < 800ms
- Compliance gate: security checklist complete if PHI sample is used

Deliverables and dates:
- Wed Aug 18: kickoff Zoom (30m) + Laura’s eval matrix draft
- Fri Aug 20: baseline run outputs pushed to Drive (Ben)
- Fri Aug 27: prompt tuning complete, interim report (Ben + Laura)
- Wed Sep 1: final POC report and acceptance decision

Attachments referenced in thread are in the Drive link Sergio shared. I’ll update the MAP with the clarified acceptance gates after this thread.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
From: Evan Brooks <evan.b@cardiotech.io>

Subject: Re: MAP: POC evaluation kickoff & roster — roles, benchmarks, timeline

All good from CardioTech — thanks for the clear owners. Two small asks:
1) If we can shift the soak window to the end of Week 2 (so we can include tuned prompts in the soak) that would be ideal.
2) I’ll share our security lead (Alex Mercer) and ask for a short intake form to speed the PHI approval.

I’ll accept the kickoff invite once Priya sends it. Looking forward to the kickoff.

—
Evan
